OFFICE OF THE SUPREME COMMANDER
FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 470 (30 Sep 45) GD
(SCAPIN-76)
APO 500
30 september 1945
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Report on Stockpiles of Military Equipment.
1. It is desired, that this headquarters be furnished at the earliest practicable date the following information on arms, ordnance ammunition, and automotive equipment:
a. Annual roduction for tne years 1941 through 1944 and production for the year 1945 through 14 August 1945.
b. Remaining estimated yearly capacity as of 14 August 1945.
c. Quantities of the above items in depot stocks as of 14 August 1945.
2. The above report will be broken down by major types, showing:
a. For arms, the numbers of units of each type weapons.
b. For ordnance ammunition, the numbers of rounds of each type.
c. For automotive equipment, the number of units of each type of vehicle and tank.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
/s/ Harold Fair
/t/ HAROLD FAIR
Lt. Col., A. G. D.,
Asst. Adjutant General
